## Description {#details}

<p>A templated base class for <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/smallptrset">SmallPtrSet</a></span> which provides the typesafe interface that is common across all small sizes.</p>


<p>This is particularly useful for passing around between interface boundaries to avoid encoding a particular small size in the interface boundary.</p>

### remove\_if() {#a4323c151516742793df95050739d72ab}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Remove elements that match the given predicate.</p>


<p>This method is a safe replacement for the following pattern, which is not valid, because the <a href="#a11045c7973ab24a8d6315b61fa337d4e">erase()</a> calls would invalidate the iterator:</p>



<pre><code>for (PtrType *Ptr : Set)
  if (Pred(P))
    Set.erase(P);
</code></pre>


<p>Returns whether anything was removed. It is safe to read the set inside the predicate function. However, the predicate must not modify the set itself, only indicate a removal by returning true.</p>


<p>Definition at line 418 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/adt/smallptrset-h">SmallPtrSet.h</a>.</p>
